name: codename
title: Codename
description: Generate random codenames for your projects in the format XX-11
author: tyounami

commands.name: index
commands.title: Generate Codename to Clipboard
commands.description: Generate a random codename with customizable format and copy to clipboard

preferences.name: customFormat
preferences.title: Format Template
preferences.description: Define your codename format using placeholders: {L}=uppercase letter, {l}=lowercase letter, {D}=digit. Leave empty for default format.
preferences.placeholder: e.g., {L}{L}-{D}{D} or PROJ-{L}{D}{D}{D} or leave empty

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
